title: Hailey Bieber Makes a Case for Cropped Cami Top After Grammys Run - NewsBreak
text:
By Ankita Shaw ,
2 hours ago Christina House / Los Angeles Times via Getty Images Hailey Bieber ‘s outfits are often masterclasses in understated elegance, and her look for a recent outing in Los Angeles was no exception, as she stepped out in a cropped cami top paired with classic blue jeans. Days after her appearance at the Grammys, photos of her look began circulating on social media on February 4, with Met Gala Crave on X posting one of them.
Hailey Bieber dons cropped cami top with jeans and heels for LA outing Hailey Bieber channelled off-duty chic in a clean, minimalist street-style look. She stepped out wearing a fitted grey cropped cami top with thin straps. The simple top highlighted her toned silhouette, and its muted tone added a soft, modern feel.
Bieber paired it with blue pipe jeans, striking the perfect balance between relaxed and polished. She completed the look with pointed black heels and a pair of slim sunglasses, adding to the model-off-duty edge. She wore her hair in a sleek bun with a middle part.
The post Hailey Bieber Makes a Case for Cropped Cami Top After Grammys Run appeared first on theFashionSpot .
